title: The Last Buna
style_block: An intimate visual style using soft natural morning light, muted earthy tones, textured film grain, and realistic medium-shot photography evoking a personal documentary.
world_block: Any person is depicted only from behind or in shadow to protect their identity, wearing traditional Ethiopian highlands cotton attire. Any village home is a small dwelling with a corrugated tin roof and a vibrant blue wooden door. Any field of the crop is a lush coffee plant with dark green leaves and bright red cherries, distinct from broadleaf plants.

reference_sheet.prompt: A cinematic reference sheet showing a weathered blue wooden door on a tin-roofed house, a clay coffee pot, fresh green grass on a dirt floor, and a lone figure seen from behind in soft morning light.

music.caption: A gentle, nostalgic instrumental score featuring a warm acoustic krar, soft ambient pads, and subtle percussive pulses. Gentle texture with no strong lead melody, evoking a cozy home in 2020s modern Ethiopia.

cues.note: Warm ambient pads introduce a quiet, reflective morning mood
Acoustic krar plucks enter gently as coffee is roasted
Melody softens to a gentle sigh during the emotional parting
Opening krar theme returns as the traveler comes back home
Music fades softly into a lingering, warm chord

end_card.text: This film was made with AI.

shots.image_prompt: A small house with a corrugated tin roof and a bright blue wooden door stands under an overcast morning sky in Jimma.

narration.am: እማዬ ዘውዲቱ ቆርቆሮ በተከደነ የጅማ ቤት ውስጥ ብቻቸውን ይኖራሉ።

shots.subtitle_en: Emaye Zewditu lives alone inside a tin roofed Jimma house.
shots.reason: Establishes the lonely setting to ground the audience in a feeling of quiet solitude.

shots.image_prompt: A person's hands carefully spread fresh green grass blades over a packed earth floor indoors.
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan left to right, fixed horizon

narration.am: ፀሐይ ሳትወጣ ወለሉ ላይ ለምለም ሣር ታነጥፋለች።

shots.subtitle_en: Before sunrise she spreads fresh green grass on the floor.
shots.reason: Connects the viewer to the tactile morning ritual of preparing the home.

shots.image_prompt: Green coffee beans roasting on a flat black iron pan over glowing charcoal embers.

narration.am: በብረት ምጣድ ላይ ጥሬ ቡና ታቆላለች።

shots.subtitle_en: She roasts green coffee beans on a flat iron pan.
shots.reason: Draws the audience into the warmth and sensory details of the coffee preparation.

shots.image_prompt: A dark clay jebena pot sits near a wisp of smoke from frankincense on a low table.

narration.am: የተቆላውን ቡና ወቅጣ በጥቁር የሸክላ ጀበና ውስጥ ታደርጋለች።

shots.subtitle_en: She pounds the dark beans into a black clay jebena.
shots.reason: Builds anticipation and cultural reverence for the brewing process.

shots.image_prompt: Two small white ceramic cups sit neatly on a woven tray next to steaming coffee.

narration.am: ሦስተኛውና የመጨረሻው የቡና ሲኒ ምርቃት ማለት ነው።

shots.subtitle_en: The third and final cup of coffee means blessing.
shots.reason: Highlights the poignant detail of the double setup that evokes longing.

shots.image_prompt: A crowded old passenger bus travels down a long dusty road leading toward a distant city skyline.

narration.am: ከሰባት ዓመት በፊት ልጇ ዳዊት ወደ አዲስ አበባ ሄደ።

shots.subtitle_en: Seven years ago her son Dawit left for Addis Ababa.
shots.reason: Visualizes the physical distance that separates family members from each other.

shots.image_prompt: An unnamed figure viewed from behind gazes out through an open doorway toward a misty horizon.

narration.am: ያ ሦስተኛው ሲኒ ሁልጊዜ የእሱ እንደሆነ ነገረችው።

shots.subtitle_en: She told him that third cup would always be his.
shots.reason: Evokes the deep emotional weight of a parting promise.

shots.image_prompt: A hand places two small white cups onto a wooden tray in the dim morning light.

narration.am: በየማለዳው በረከቦቱ ላይ ሁለት አነስተኛ ነጭ ሲኒዎችን ታዘጋጃለች።

shots.subtitle_en: Every morning she sets two small white cups on trays.
shots.reason: Emphasizes the daily repetition of waiting and holding onto hope.

shots.image_prompt: An empty low wooden stool sits beside a vibrant blue door in an empty courtyard.

narration.am: ሁለቱን ሲኒዎች ጠጥታ ሦስተኛውን ሲኒ እንዲጠብቅ ታስቀራለች።

shots.subtitle_en: She drinks two cups and leaves the third cup waiting.
shots.reason: Leaves the viewer with a strong feeling of absence and patient longing.

shots.image_prompt: A bright blue wooden door swings open inward, revealing a rain-streaked threshold and soft morning light.

narration.am: በአንድ ዝናባማ ማለዳ ቡናው ሳይፈላ ሰማያዊው በር ተከፈተ።

shots.subtitle_en: One rainy morning the blue door opens before coffee boils.
shots.reason: Sparks a sudden shift from longing to unexpected joy and surprise.

shots.image_prompt: A figure sits down on a low wooden stool outside a blue door, resting a dusty canvas bag on the ground.

narration.am: ዳዊት አቧራ የለበሰ ቦርሳ ይዞ ደረሰና ተቀመጠ።

shots.subtitle_en: Dawit arrives with a dusty bag and sits down.
shots.reason: Brings the emotional journey full circle with a sense of homecoming.

shots.image_prompt: A hand pours dark coffee from a black clay pot into a small white cup held by another.

narration.am: በዚያች ማለዳ ዳዊት ሦስተኛውን ሲኒ ለእእናቱ ቀዳ።

shots.subtitle_en: That morning Dawit pours the third cup for his mother.
shots.reason: Leaves the audience with a profound feeling of love, reunion, and blessing.
